summary.content:
Today's selection covers 63 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 40 on Artificial Intelligence and 8 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI teases Astra, its next major AI model, after it solves 10 long-standing math problems
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: ESET tracks rise in malicious AI skills and adaptable malware
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BleepingComputer, The Verge, TechCrunch, NY Times Tech, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 8 articles published in the last 24 hours
